body:
When a task that has no feature is completed, its last review's `### Tech debt` findings go to a new Tech Debt task in Planning. It shows on the board right away.

## Today (D-112)
Only tasks with a feature get tech debt filed. `board.brief` asks only their reviews for the `### Tech debt` section (`board.TECH_DEBT_ASK`), and `board.tech_debt` returns nothing when the task has no feature.

## Change
- Reviews of every task get asked for the section. The wording should no longer say "part of a feature".
- If the completed task has no feature, `board.tech_debt` creates a task with `techDebt: true`:
  - in `planning`, or the first column if the workflow has none, as D-132 says;
  - with no feature and no milestone;
  - with the completed task's `scope` and `home`;
  - titled `<task title>: Tech Debt`;
  - with one `solace` note per finding, as today.
- The completed task gets the note naming it, as today.
- Tasks with a feature work as they do today.

## Done when
- `board::tests` cover a task with no feature filing a new Tech Debt task, and one with no section filing nothing.
- D-112 is amended by a new decision, and Spec 15 §6 and A20 are updated.
title: tech debt: file for tasks with no feature
